warm-off-white.$description: Warm Off-White — Primary headlines, body text, nav links — the warm cream reads softer than pure white against the charcoal canvas

bone-gray.$description: Bone Gray — Secondary text, captions, muted labels — the midtone that separates from Off-White without losing warmth

pale-stone.$description: Pale Stone — Tertiary text, ghost button labels, low-emphasis copy

faint-linen.$description: Faint Linen — Hairline borders, subtle dividers, selected state outlines

smoke-charcoal.$description: Smoke Charcoal — Card surfaces, nested panels, terminal window backgrounds

iron-veil.$description: Iron Veil — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

slate-hearth.$description: Slate Hearth — Highest surface elevation — modal overlays, floating panels

deep-ember.$description: Deep Ember — Page canvas, section backgrounds — the warm near-black that grounds the whole system

smoked-onyx.$description: Smoked Onyx — Footer, banded section backgrounds, subtle vertical shifts

absolute.$description: Absolute — Deepest dark, nav text, icon strokes, image masks

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Deep text, hairline borders that must disappear into the canvas

gold-leaf.$description: Gold Leaf — Code syntax strings, keyword highlights, inline emphasis — appears only inside terminal content, never as a UI button

muted-cobalt.$description: Muted Cobalt — Code syntax identifiers, secondary link text, tag accents — the cool counterpoint to the warm gold

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

matter.$description: Primary typeface for all UI text — headlines, body, nav, and labels. Custom geometric grotesque with mechanical rhythm; the signature custom font. Letter-spacing tightens aggressively at display sizes (-0.030em at 56-68px) and opens wide for tracked small caps (0.200em at 11px), giving the system two distinct voices from one family.

geist-mono.$description: Command-line strings inside buttons and inline code chips — the only monospace that touches user-facing UI

matter-mono.$description: Monospaced variant of Matter for code blocks and product mockup bodies

inter.$description: Secondary support face for body copy where Matter licensing is unavailable; rare in the system

matter-regular.$description: Matter Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

matter-sq-regular.$description: Matter SQ Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
